Gongduino factory — third-party 3D models

The three generic source models below are released under CC0 1.0 Universal:
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

mg400-rigged.glb — user-supplied DOBOT MG400.stl, segmented into nine CAD parts.
Four active axes and the coupled parallel linkage are reconstructed for animation.
Official per-link reference: https://github.com/Dobot-Arm/MG400_ROS
The output robot geometry comes from the supplied STL, not the reference meshes.
The existing Innerscene mobile base is retained; the old arm is removed.
A procedural carton gripper is added. MG400 is displayed at 3x scale in the factory.
The supplied CAD is NOT covered by the generic models' CC0 statement.
See MG400-PROVENANCE.json for the source hash and reconstruction details.

amr.glb — AMR with arm, Innerscene (original generic design)
amr-rigged.glb — same source, separated into yaw, shoulder, elbow, wrist and finger
joints for live pick-and-place. Wrist shortened and a gripper cross-slide added.
https://www.innerscene.com/tools/library/3d-parts/amr-with-arm-6dd4556c
Source: https://files.innerscene.com/library/amr-with-arm-6dd4556c/1acce422a5bf1424a275/amr-with-arm.glb

truck.glb — 7.5 t class box truck with roll-up door, Innerscene (original generic design)
https://www.innerscene.com/tools/library/3d-parts/7-5-t-class-box-truck-with-roll-up-door-12baea66
Source: https://files.innerscene.com/library/7-5-t-class-box-truck-with-roll-up-door-12baea66/286c7a3a7174b81d13ed/7-5-t-class-box-truck-with-roll-up-door.glb

conveyor.glb — Powered belt conveyor, 4 m straight, 3D Assets
https://3dassets.dev/assets/parcel-depot-and-sorting-hall-parcel-depot-and-sorting-87ae9888
Source: https://cdn.3dassets.dev/assets/34783/v1/model.glb
Source page reports AI-assisted creation (Claude Opus 5).

Adaptations: textures resized to a maximum of 512 px, duplicate geometry removed,
static meshes joined by material, vertex data quantized, and scene scale/orientation
adjusted. Source conveyor roller animation retained. Models are visualization assets,
not manufacturer CAD or manufacturing specifications.

Three.js r128 and its loaders/controls/environment use the MIT license.
See ../vendor/THREE-LICENSE.txt.
